criteria.requirement: Allow case-insensitive X- extension properties at VTIMEZONE and STANDARD/DAYLIGHT component levels in tzical, ignoring their content as nonexecuting metadata. Preserve existing transition/offset/recurrence behavior, required TZID/DTSTART/offset checks, malformed BEGIN/END and unknown NON-X standard property errors. Parameters and repeated X properties are harmless; do not fetch TZURL/X URLs, import code or relax validation for ordinary properties.
